name: gk-engineering
description: Project-agnostic, scope-sized delivery with declarative target and safety profiles, audited model routing, evidence revalidation, fail-closed completion receipts, and Goal retrospectives.

interface.shortDescription: Profile-driven delivery with fail-closed evidence gates.
interface.longDescription: Sizes approved work before planning, keeps project-specific targets, protected resources, external effects, acceptance journeys, verification commands, and rollback actions in a declarative Profile, audits model routing and runtime provenance, supports explicit evidence revalidation, issues completion receipts only after immutable-input validation, and produces an auditable post-completion Goal retrospective.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $product-to-delivery to guide this feature from discovery through approved and verified delivery.
